name: lanun_horseman
description: a Lanun Horseman, a tanned pirate rider with a long dark ponytail under a gold-trimmed blue tricorn hat, a blue coat with gold trim over a white shirt, a red sash and red breeches with dark boots, a steel-tipped wooden spear held upright in his LEFT hand and a round blue-and-white shield with a gold anchor emblem on his RIGHT arm, riding a brown horse with a white blaze, a black mane and tail and dark hooves
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round anchor shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
